modal.title: The ride downtown, rebuilt
modal.text: A real house now: a shingle roof with a brick chimney and a TV antenna, siding, lit windows, a back door with a porch light, and a garage.
modal.label: The Path v0.5: The ride downtown, rebuilt

modal.title: The controller stays with the duel
modal.text: In The Current's duel, the controller no longer also acts on the world behind it.
modal.label: Beyond the Nexus Log 04c: The controller stays with the duel

modal.title: Continue is there when you come back
modal.text: After the ending, the Continue to Beyond the Nexus button now shows on the opening screen straight away.
modal.label: The First World v0.12.3: Continue is there when you come back

modal.title: Playable on the web, up to The Current
modal.text: A concept build of Beyond the Nexus now plays in the browser, from the Nexus to The Current.
modal.label: Beyond the Nexus Log 04b: Playable on the web, up to The Current

modal.title: The Current wakes, and the music gets real
modal.text: A new kind of duel on the River road, and battle music played by an orchestra.
modal.label: Beyond the Nexus Log 04: The Current wakes, and the music gets real

modal.title: On to Beyond the Nexus
modal.text: The true ending now offers a real choice: go on to the next game, Beyond the Nexus, or stay on your island.
modal.label: The First World v0.12.2: On to Beyond the Nexus

modal.title: A steadier hand
modal.text: Two fixes to the hand from a playtest: it never gets stuck after turning the camera, and things by the shore come up when you reach for them.
modal.label: The First World v0.12.1: A steadier hand

modal.title: THE JUNCTION's floor, rebuilt
modal.text: Each game on the floor now has 5 to 8 stages, each with something new, and a final boss or finale that wins it: lives and an extra life, a card before each stage and a bonus count after it.
modal.label: The Path v0.4: THE JUNCTION's floor, rebuilt

log.title: After the ending
log.text: Stay on your island after the true ending and Telor keeps living: a festival every season, newcomers arriving by boat, and a city that grows while you look after it.
log.label: The First World v0.12: After the ending

log.title: One arcade, two shelves
log.text: The aisle now has two shelves, the same on the big screen and the web: our games first, then all 26 cabinets in one row.

log.title: Our games first
log.text: The arcade opens on our games, with larger card art on the tube. Pick one to visit its public game or development page; all 26 cabinets are still a shelf away.
